sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Identify the adverb in the sentence: The old man walked slowly towards the glowing tank.
Choose the correct conjunction to join the sentences: Jumman was happy, ____ Algu was worried about the decision.
In the poem 'Vocation', what does the watchman swing while walking in the dark street?
Choose the passive voice of: The boy hit the gilli.
options: A) The gilli was hit by the boy.
B) The boy is hitting the gilli.
C) The gilli is being hit by the boy.
D) The gilli hits the boy.
questions.answer: A) The gilli was hit by the boy.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct indirect speech for: He said, 'I am reading a book.'
options: A) He said that he was reading a book.
B) He said that I am reading a book.
C) He says he was reading a book.
D) He said he is reading a book.
questions.answer: A) He said that he was reading a book.

questions.question_text: What is the primary equipment needed to play Gilli Danda?
options: A) A bat and a rubber ball
B) A large stick and a small oval wooden piece
C) A glass bangle and a string
D) A metal tank and water
questions.answer: B) A large stick and a small oval wooden piece

questions.question_text: Which interjection best fits the sentence: '____! We have won the Gilli Danda tournament!'
What is the antonym of the word 'wise' as used in the story 'The Decision of the Panchayat'?
What sound do the glass bangles make when they touch each other?
Fill in the blank with the correct preposition: The boys sat ____ the large banyan tree to rest after the game.

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: Why was Algu Chowdhary hesitant to give a decision against Jumman Sheikh in the Panchayat? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Algu was hesitant because Jumman was his best friend. He feared that giving a fair decision against him would completely destroy their close, long-standing friendship.

questions.question_text: Change the following sentence into the passive voice: 'The old woman sells beautiful glass bangles.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The passive voice of the sentence is: 'Beautiful glass bangles are sold by the old woman.' The object becomes the subject of the new sentence.

questions.question_text: Describe the appearance of the tank mentioned in the story 'What a Tank'. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The tank was an enormous, fascinating metal machine with heavy caterpillar tracks. It looked like a giant iron fortress slowly rolling across the dusty village ground.

questions.question_text: Convert this direct speech into indirect speech: The child said, 'I want to be a gardener.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The correct indirect speech is: The child said that he wanted to be a gardener. We change the present tense verb into the past tense form.

questions.question_text: Write a synonym for the word 'justice' and use it in a meaningful sentence about a Panchayat. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A synonym for justice is 'fairness'. Sentence: The villagers gathered to ensure that fairness was delivered to the poor widow by the village council members.

questions.question_text: Explain how playing Gilli Danda brings immense joy to the village children despite having no expensive equipment. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Gilli Danda requires only simple wooden sticks, yet it brings immense thrill and competition. The children experience pure freedom, climbing trees and running in open fields. Their joy comes from deep friendships, outdoor adventure, and escaping strict rules, proving happiness doesn't need expensive toys.

questions.question_text: Based on the poem 'Vocation', why do you think the young boy is so fascinated by the lives of everyday workers? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The young boy feels trapped by his strict daily routine and school rules. He is fascinated by the hawker, gardener, and watchman because they seem completely free. They can walk anywhere, dig in the dirt, and stay up late without anyone scolding them.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Applied Composition

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph describing the vibrant atmosphere of a bangle seller's cart in your local market. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The bangle seller’s cart is a magical sight, glowing with circles of red, blue, and gold. The glass bangles sparkle brightly under the sun, clinking together like tiny bells. Women and children crowd around the cart, excitedly matching colors with their festive clothes, bringing life and cheer to the bustling market.

questions.question_text: Write a short informal letter to your friend inviting them to play a friendly match of Gilli Danda this weekend. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Dear Rohan, I hope you are doing well. This Sunday, all our friends are gathering at the big village ground to play an exciting match of Gilli Danda. We have carved new wooden sticks just for this game! Please come by 4 PM so we can enjoy a great evening together. Yours truly, Amit.
